description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the CandidateShortlistingAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment module, including methods for getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, with test data setup and mock service registration.

classes.name: CandidateShortlistingAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateShortlistingAPI endpoints related to candidate shortlisting in the recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, clears specific test data from CandidateHistory table.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of the CandidateShortlistingAPI, expecting a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for getOne method, expecting a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update method of the API with different test cases, involving fixtures, mock services, and validation.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for testUpdate method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of the CandidateShortlistingAPI, expecting a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for delete method, expecting a NotImplementedException.
